regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: T6CL04 accepts WS-WORK-DAYS-TO-CLOSE directly (no calendar-day concept exists anywhere in the program) and computes WS-EXCESS-WORK-DAYS = WS-WORK-DAYS-TO-CLOSE - 7 (lines 17-18), multiplied by 500. The entire accrual is working-day based, not calendar_day as clause 19 requires.
